title: Language and Literacies Pedagogy
description: Examines learning in language arts in elementary and middle school. Emphasis is given to oral language and literacy development in consideration of multiple and diverse contexts using oral, written, visual and digital texts. Valuing diverse ways of knowing and learning is integral to implementing strategies for supporting and assessing the needs of all learners.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of EDCI 301, EDCI 302.
May be offered in English or French.
